betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.allowEndPor: If enabled, operators can use /betelskyblock generate_end_portal to generate a complete End Portal. This is mainly intended for Betel Skyblock worlds.
betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.enableClass: If enabled, the classic Betel Skyblock island will generate when the classic skyblock world preset is selected.
betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.classicIsla: Controls the Y level where the classic Betel Skyblock island generates. Default: 128.
betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.classicGene: If enabled, the classic Betel Skyblock island will generate a starter chest.
betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.classicEnab: If enabled, players falling into the void in classic Betel Skyblock will be returned to the island.
betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.classicGive: If enabled, the starter chest will include the Betel Skyblock Guide.
betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.enableOneBl: If enabled, the extreme one block skyblock mode will generate when the one block world preset is selected.
betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.oneBlockY.t: Controls the Y level of the single Betel Nut Residue Block. Default: 128.
betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.oneBlockGiv: If enabled, players will receive starter items the first time they enter Betel One Block Skyblock.
betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.oneBlockEna: If enabled, players falling into the void in Betel One Block Skyblock will be returned above the single block.
betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.oneBlockSta: The number of betel nuts given when a player first enters Betel One Block Skyblock. Set to 0 to disable.
The number of betel saplings given when a player first enters Betel One Block Skyblock. Set to 0 to disable.
The number of dirt blocks given when a player first enters Betel One Block Skyblock. Set to 0 to disable.
betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.residueComp: The chance for Betel Nut Residue to add a compost level. Recommended range: 0.0 to 1.0. A game restart may be required.
betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.residueBloc: The chance for a Betel Nut Residue Block to add a compost level. Recommended range: 0.0 to 1.0. A game restart may be required.
betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.enableEndFr: If enabled, players can throw Ender Eyes and Hecheng Tianxia Betel Nuts into water in Betel Skyblock worlds to summon lightning and obtain End Portal Frames. This does not work in normal worlds.
betel-nut-mod.midnightconfig.endFrameRit: The number of Ender Eyes consumed by the water lightning ritual. Default: 16.
The number of Hecheng Tianxia Betel Nuts consumed by the water lightning ritual. Default: 12.
The number of End Portal Frames generated after a successful ritual. Default: 12.
How often the water lightning ritual checks for items, in ticks. Default: 20.

message.betel-nut-mod.one_block_welcome:
Welcome to Betel One Block Skyblock.
You only have one Betel Nut Residue Block, one betel palm sapling, one dirt block, and one betel nut.
Eat the betel nut to obtain betel nut residue.
What happens next is up to you.
This mod content is only game design, not real health advice, and does not encourage eating betel nuts in real life.
book.betel-nut-mod.skyblock_guide.page1:
Welcome to Betel Skyblock.
Resources are extremely limited here, so you must rely on betel nuts to build your first resource loop.
book.betel-nut-mod.skyblock_guide.page2:
After eating betel nuts, you receive betel nut residue.
Residue can be placed in a composter to obtain bone meal.
book.betel-nut-mod.skyblock_guide.page3:
Bone meal can grow betel palm trees.
Betel palm trees continue producing betel nuts.
This is the most important early skyblock loop.
book.betel-nut-mod.skyblock_guide.page4:
9 betel nut residue items can craft 1 Betel Nut Residue Block.
Residue blocks are the basic blocks for expanding the island.
book.betel-nut-mod.skyblock_guide.page5: Note: this mod content is only game design, not real health advice, and does not encourage eating betel nuts in real life.
